value.name: checks desk drawer
value.description: The speaker goes to the desk and finds the drawer already open.
evidence: went to the desk and the drawer was already open.

value.name: discovers folder missing
value.description: The speaker realizes the folder is gone from the drawer.

value.name: suspects Lucia took folder
value.description: The speaker briefly thinks Lucia may have taken the missing folder.
evidence: I thought perhaps Lucia had taken it.

value.name: finds Lucia in kitchen
value.description: The speaker goes down to the kitchen and sees Lucia sitting at the table with coffee.
evidence: I went down to the kitchen and Lucia was at the table with her coffee

value.name: confirms Lucia stayed downstairs
value.description: The speaker learns Lucia has not been upstairs that morning, ruling her out as the one who took the folder.
evidence: she had not been upstairs yet that morning.
